newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gillette estimates shaved.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gillette estimates shaved.

text.p: Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Monday it was shaving earnings estimates for 1997 for Gillette Co due to lower-than-expected results at its Braun division.

-- Braun's results were depressed by economic factors in Europe and Japan and some one-time costs; Braun is Gillette's most economically sensitive division, and these markets account for a little more than half of Braun's total sales, Rodman & Renshaw said in a research report.
-- Rodman & Renshaw lowered its 1997 earnings estimate to $2.60 a share from $2.55.
-- All other aspects of Gillette's business are on track, Rodman & Renshaw said in a report.
-- Shares of Gillette were off 4-3/8 to 81-1/2.
